address: DIFC, Gate Avenue, South Zone, Dubai
bio: Set over two levels within DIFC, this Dubai outpost of the Florentine original is a handsome creation – to find it just look out for the bright green door. The main dining room is set around an open kitchen, while upstairs hosts a stylish and comfortable lounge. Meanwhile, the menu boasts all the Italian classics, including chef’s signature ‘calamarata 2.0’ and ricciola e melone....
